findings: In formation, change the label from mixed to phonosemantic or disputed. The current account identifies 凡 as phonetic and the lower marks as pictorial traces of feathers; the project taxonomy accepts pictorial meaning plus phonetic role as phonosemantic. Do not imply a separate semantic element.

In learner.overview, qualify the proposed sound-based borrowing: the early bird graph was used for wind, but its spoken name is uncertain, so say the words may have sounded alike rather than asserting that they did. Preserve the bird identity and name as unresolved.
